purpose: Teach: 思想家/松山/結城/侍/みえる/回戦/移さ/舞台裏

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近代の、本気で、絶対、思想家、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, you handled modern philosophy incredibly thoroughly in your paper. I'm genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, measured opening. Steady eye contact. Clear articulation of genuine admiration. Unhurried pace that shows she's speaking from careful thought, not reflex.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。本気で、絶対、松山、絶対、の文学、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really tried to explore Matsuyama's literary tradition deeply in the research. I'm grateful for your guidance.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Slight lift in voice on the thanks, then settling into thoughtful explanation. Earnest without being strained. Small pause before 'grateful,' showing he means it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、結城、絶対、紬の、絶対、伝統、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you wove in the Yuki-tsumugi textile tradition—that was particularly thoughtful.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational. Slight nod in the voice. Slower tempo, savoring the specific detail. Warm recognition that he went beyond the obvious.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。中世の、本気で、絶対、侍、絶対、文化、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to connect medieval samurai culture to the broader historical narrative. Thank you for pushing me to dig deeper.
lines.style: Steady, grounded response. Confident without arrogance. Each phrase lands with quiet intention. Genuine gratitude in the final clause, not a formality.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 未来図に、本気で、絶対、みえる、絶対、社会像、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your vision of the future society—how you developed that through your research—it shows real maturity.
lines.style: Engaged but unhurried. Slight warmth on 'maturity.' Deliberate pacing that gives weight to the observation. Teaching voice at its most genuine.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。第一、本気で、絶対、回戦、絶対、の、絶対、データ、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I tried to ground the abstract concepts in concrete historical data. I really appreciate how you helped me refine the argument.
lines.style: Focused, clear-headed. Respectful cadence. Slight emphasis on 'concrete' and 'data'—showing intellectual rigor. Closing with genuine thanks, not politeness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文化財、本気で、絶対、移さ、絶対、れた、絶対、博物館、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The cultural artifacts you examined—especially how you traced them through the museum collections—that was meticulous work.
lines.style: Appreciative, almost delighted. Slight upward lilt on the specifics. Warm, unhurried delivery. Teacher voice recognizing real scholarly care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。劇場の、本気で、絶対、舞台裏、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The theater's backstage history was less documented, but I wanted to give it proper attention. Thank you for believing in the research.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Respectful closing. Steady pace. The 'thank you' is genuine and slightly vulnerable—he knows he took a risk with the topic choice.
